One predictable entry into the platform

A shared login experience gives users and consuming applications a consistent authentication boundary. Sessions and credentials remain owned by Security, so individual business domains do not need to implement or store their own sign-in state.

The steps below describe the visible user journey through that boundary.

Logging In to the Portal

When you visit your portal in your browser, the first page you’re greeted with is the login page that looks something like this:

Here, you must enter your “User Name” and “Password” to the account you want to access and click the “Submit” button to gain access.
